info.description: SEA-LION-Guard v2 safety and action-governance decision model for Southeast Asian languages, fine-tuned from Gemma 4 E4B. Instead of free text it returns probabilities for content moderation (safe / sensitive / unsafe), rule applicability and rule violation, and supports multi-turn evaluation, bring-your-own-policy rules and tool-call evaluation. Open weights under MIT with a 128K-token context; no public per-token API price.

zh.description: SEA-LION-Guard v2 安全与行为治理决策模型，面向东南亚语言，基于 Gemma 4 E4B 微调。不生成自由文本，而是返回内容审核（安全 / 敏感 / 不安全）、规则适用性与规则违反的概率，支持多轮对话评估、自定义策略规则与工具调用评估。开放权重，MIT 许可，上下文 128K tokens；官方未公布按量 API 价格。

sources.title: Safeguarding Regional Agents: Announcing Gemma-SEA-LION-Guard-v2 (31B, E4B, E2B) | SEA-LION (2026-10-21)
